meta.title: Baha Ready 3D
meta.description: A 3D game for learning flood and typhoon preparedness, from Signal No. 1 to Signal No. 5.

landing.headline: Get ready before the water rises.
landing.lede: Pack a go-bag, prepare the house, and evacuate safely as the storm signal climbs. Every level explains what you did right and why.
landing.meterLabel: Levels from Signal No. 1 to Signal No. 5
landing.feature1Title: A go-bag at the right weight
landing.feature1Body: Pick what you really need. Weight and time are limited.
landing.feature2Body: Avoid live wires, open manholes, and strong currents.
landing.feature3Body: Guide elderly people, children, and PWDs to the evacuation center.

auth.signInLede: Pick up where you left off. We'll email you a 6-digit code.
auth.signUpLede: It's free. Save your progress and unlock Signal No. 2 to No. 5.
auth.codeSentTo: We sent a 6-digit code to {email}. It expires in 5 minutes.
auth.attemptsLeft: {count, plural, one {# try left} other {# tries left}}
auth.signInHint: If you don't have an account yet, create one first to receive a code.
auth.forgotLede: Enter your email. We'll send a code so you can set a new password.
auth.newPasswordHint: At least 10 characters. Use words that are easy to remember but hard to guess.
auth.privacyNote: By signing up, you agree to our Privacy Notice and Terms.
auth.typeFacilitatorHint: Teachers, SK, barangay or MDRRMO staff
auth.facilitatorSteps: How it works: verify your email → complete your profile and facilitator details → an admin approves your account and you get an email. You can play while you wait.

mfa.title: Two-factor authentication
mfa.challengeLede: Open your authenticator app (e.g. Google Authenticator) and enter the 6-digit code.
mfa.setupLede: Facilitators and admins need this to protect students' and residents' data.
mfa.step1: Install Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, or a similar app.
mfa.step2: Scan this QR code with the app.
mfa.step3: Enter the 6-digit code shown in the app.
mfa.codeInvalid: That code didn't match. Wait for a fresh code in your authenticator app and try again. If it keeps failing, make sure your phone's date & time is set to automatic.
mfa.clockSkew: This device's clock is off by about {minutes} min. If your authenticator app is on this device, codes won't match. Turn on automatic date & time, then try again.

onboarding.title: Set up your profile
onboarding.usernameHint: 3–20 characters: letters, numbers, or _. This is what others see on leaderboards.
onboarding.minorNotice: Since you're under 18, let a parent or guardian know you're using Baha Ready. We won't ask for any more personal information.
onboarding.consentLabel: I have read and agree to the Privacy Notice. I understand others only see my username.
onboarding.facStepLede: An admin reviews these before the facilitator tools unlock. Only admins can see them.
onboarding.facSubmitFailed: Your profile is saved, but the facilitator application didn't go through. Please send it again here.
